# Playtest log

One file per session, or one file with a session table. Feeds Stage 3 and Stage 10.

**Codename:**
**Build / commit:**
**Date:**
**Player:** founder / friend / other (no unnecessary PII)
**Device:**
**OS:**
**Session duration:**

## Scores

| Prompt | Value |
|--------|--------|
| Fun (1–10) | |
| Instant understandability (1–10) | |
| Voluntary restarts (count) | |
| Would play again? | YES / NO |
| Retry urge after fail? | YES / NO / DID NOT FAIL |

## Moments

| Type | What happened |
|------|----------------|
| Near-miss / tension | |
| Satisfaction / juice | |
| Friction / confusion | |
| Control problem | |
